tier2_candidates.headline: As India Temporarily Bans Telegram, Which Other Countries Have Restricted the Messaging App?
tier2_candidates.snippet: Several countries have restricted the messaging app, a valuable platform for dissidents, criminals and extremists. Here’s an overview.
